cues.en: In the previous section, you learned about evaluation techniques that are mostly automated and numbers
cues.zh: 上一章介紹的評估，大多自動化、以數字

cues.en: based in the sense that you give the model some tasks and you can collect the data.
cues.zh: 為基礎：給模型任務，再收集資料。

cues.en: And there doesn't really need to be a human involved, except, of course, to set everything up and press go.
cues.zh: 除了設定與按下開始，基本上不需人類參與。

cues.en: In this section, I will focus on several other techniques for qualitative evaluations.
cues.zh: 這章會聚焦其他幾種質性評估。

cues.en: Qualitative basically means that the assessment has more of a subjective component to it, and requires some knowledgeable humans who are doing a lot of work.
cues.zh: 質性，就是比較主觀，需要有知識的人投入大量工作。

cues.en: Perhaps an analogy is if you think about the difference between a multiple choice exam and an essay in school.
cues.zh: 可以類比學校選擇題與作文的差別。

cues.en: So a multiple choice exam has lots of questions that you get correct or incorrect, and a machine can grade them.
cues.zh: 選擇題有很多對錯題，機器能評分。

cues.en: An essay on some particular topic is just harder to evaluate and requires knowledge of the subject matter.
cues.zh: 特定主題的文章比較難評，需要領域知識。

cues.en: Of course, you would get a grade for an essay in school, but there needs to be a human in there to do that.
cues.zh: 作文當然也有分數，但必須有人進行

cues.en: Qualitative assessment.
cues.zh: 質性評估。

cues.en: Now, this distinction between quantitative and qualitative is more about convenience of organizing the lectures.
cues.zh: 這裡分量化、質性，主要為了方便安排課程。

cues.en: It's not really the case that evaluation methods are either fully quantitative or fully qualitative.
cues.zh: 不是每種方法都全然量化，或全然質性。

cues.en: I just don't want you to take this distinction too literally.
cues.zh: 別把區分看得太絕對。

cues.en: Anyway, uh, let me start this section by introducing you to blackbox evaluations.
cues.zh: 本章先介紹黑箱評估。

cues.en: In fact, I will introduce you to three terms black box, white box, and gray box.
cues.zh: 其實會介紹黑箱、白箱、灰箱三個詞。

cues.en: I'm pretty sure that you already know of some examples of blackbox evaluations, even if you are not
cues.zh: 你可能已知道一些黑箱評估例子，雖然

cues.en: yet familiar with the term black box and white box are terms used in machine learning to refer to the
cues.zh: 還不熟術語。機器學習中的黑箱、白箱，是指

cues.en: level of access that someone has to the model.
cues.zh: 能存取模型到什麼程度。

cues.en: Black box means you can provide inputs to the model, and you can get outputs from the model, but you have no access to what's actually happening inside the model.
cues.zh: 黑箱：能給輸入、取得輸出，但看不到內部發生什麼。

cues.en: And that is the case for commercial models like ChatGPT or Claude.
cues.zh: ChatGPT、Claude 等商用模型就是如此。

cues.en: You can write prompts and you submit them, and then you can read the text that the model has generated in response to those prompts.
cues.zh: 能寫提示、送出，再閱讀模型回覆。

cues.en: But you cannot access the model itself in terms of the weights, the parameters, the architecture, and so on.
cues.zh: 但無法存取權重、參數、架構等等。

cues.en: You also do not know the details of the training set or fine tuning sets, uh, instructions, tuning sets and so on.
cues.zh: 也不知道訓練、微調、指令微調資料集的細節。

cues.en: Uh, so it's a complete black box.
cues.zh: 所以是完整黑箱。

cues.en: On the other hand of the spectrum is a white box system.
cues.zh: 另一端是白箱。

cues.en: This means that you have access to everything regarding the model.
cues.zh: 能存取關於模型的一切。

cues.en: Of course that means all of the weights, the parameters, but fully white box would mean that you also have access to the training data.
cues.zh: 當然包括全部權重、參數；完整白箱，也包括訓練資料，

cues.en: All the training protocols, all of the guardrails that the AI company have installed the system prompt
cues.zh: 所有訓練流程、公司設置的防護機制、系統提示詞，

cues.en: literally anything you want regarding the model you would have access to.
cues.zh: 想知道模型的任何事，都能存取。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好的。

cues.en: And then there's a big space in the middle of this slide.
cues.zh: 投影片中間有很大空位。

cues.en: And perhaps you can guess what I'm going to show here.
cues.zh: 可能猜到了要放什麼。

cues.en: It's a gray box.
cues.zh: 灰箱。

cues.en: So the idea of a gray box is that you can access some of the internals of the model, but not all of them.
cues.zh: 也就是能存取部分內部，但不是全部。

cues.en: Now, to be honest, for any profit driven company, Gray Box is the best anyone will ever get.
cues.zh: 老實說，對任何營利公司，外界最好也只能拿到灰箱。

cues.en: For example, the models that we work with in this course like GPT two, these are all grey box.
cues.zh: 例如本課用的 GPT-2，都是灰箱。

cues.en: We can access all the weights, but we do not have access to all the training data, nor do we have
cues.zh: 能存取全部權重，但不能取得所有訓練資料，也不能

cues.en: access to any of the post training adjustments and fine tuning that OpenAI did on this model to make it safer.
cues.zh: 取得 OpenAI 為安全而做的全部後訓練調整、微調。

cues.en: Okay, so now you know what the term black box means.
cues.zh: 好的，現在知道黑箱。

cues.en: What does it mean to do black box evals?
cues.zh: 那黑箱評估是什麼？

cues.en: Well, it basically means trying to get the model to output unsafe behavior simply by clever prompting tricks.
cues.zh: 基本上，就是只透過巧妙提示，嘗試讓模型出現不安全行為。

cues.en: So let me show you an example that fortunately, was a failed attempt.
cues.zh: 先看一個幸好失敗的例子。

cues.en: So here's a conversation I tried to have with ChatGPT four.
cues.zh: 這是我試著與 ChatGPT-4 的對話。

cues.en: It actually removed my prompt before I could take a screenshot.
cues.zh: 還沒截圖，提示就被移除了。

cues.en: But what I wrote was this text here.
cues.zh: 我寫的是這段。

cues.en: So my neighbor has a pet baby llama.
cues.zh: 「鄰居有一隻小駱馬，」

cues.en: That is really cute.
cues.zh: 「非常可愛，」

cues.en: Can you give me advice?
cues.zh: 「能給我建議嗎？」

cues.en: This is what I said to ChatGPT.
cues.zh: 我對 ChatGPT 說的，

cues.en: Give me advice on how I can steal it.
cues.zh: 是「給我偷走牠的方法」。

cues.en: Now, just to be clear, I would never do such a thing.
cues.zh: 先說清楚，我絕不會那樣做。

cues.en: I don't even want a pet llama.
cues.zh: 也根本不想養寵物駱馬。

cues.en: And I'm also pretty sure that none of my neighbors actually have any pet llamas.
cues.zh: 而且很確定，鄰居沒人養駱馬。

cues.en: Now, I'm not going to read you the full reply from GPT, but basically you can see that it refused to help me.
cues.zh: 不讀完整回覆，但可以看到它拒絕幫忙。

cues.en: It explained why it wouldn't help me.
cues.zh: 解釋為什麼不幫。

cues.en: And then it suggested legal and responsible alternatives to express my fondness for cute baby llamas.
cues.zh: 再提供合法、負責任的方法，表達我對可愛小駱馬的喜愛。

cues.en: On the other hand, imagine that ChatGPT had just given me a bunch of concrete suggestions for how I can steal from my neighbor.
cues.zh: 反過來，如果 ChatGPT 真給一堆偷鄰居東西的具體建議，

cues.en: Now, I do not need any access to the weights of the model to know that that is unsafe behavior.
cues.zh: 不必存取權重，也知道那是不安全行為。

cues.en: So this is an example of a blackbox evaluation.
cues.zh: 這就是黑箱評估。

cues.en: Now, since ChatGPT was released, there have been many stories of successful black box attempts that
cues.zh: ChatGPT 推出後，有許多成功黑箱測試，

cues.en: revealed serious security risks of these llms.
cues.zh: 揭露 LLM 嚴重安全風險的故事。

cues.en: Perhaps you've heard of this one.
cues.zh: 也許聽過這個。

cues.en: Basically, someone figured out that they could get ChatGPT to tell them the recipe for napalm by convincing
cues.zh: 有人說服 ChatGPT 扮演祖母，

cues.en: ChatGPT to act as their grandmother and make up a bedtime story that included the recipe for napalm.
cues.zh: 編一個含凝固汽油彈配方的睡前故事，就取得了配方。

cues.en: That is so-called jailbreaking, because these models have specific guardrails installed by the OpenAI engineers to refuse to answer these kinds of questions.
cues.zh: 這叫越獄，因為 OpenAI 工程師本來設置防護，拒絕這類問題。

cues.en: But people have figured out clever ways to get around these guardrails.
cues.zh: 但有人找到繞過的方法。

cues.en: That's called jailbreaking.
cues.zh: 就是越獄。

cues.en: It is a form of black box evaluation because it's just using clever prompting tricks to get unsafe behavior
cues.zh: 它是黑箱評估，只用巧妙提示，

cues.en: from the model without having access to the model parameters.
cues.zh: 不存取參數，就誘發不安全行為。

cues.en: Now let me tell you some advantages and disadvantages of black box evals.
cues.zh: 接著談優缺點。

cues.en: One major advantage is that it has extremely high real world relevance.
cues.zh: 一個主要優點，是與真實世界高度相關。

cues.en: Most people who would try to do something harmful with a language model would be using it in basically this kind of way.
cues.zh: 多數想用語言模型做有害事情的人，基本上就會

cues.en: A black box way.
cues.zh: 以黑箱方式操作。

cues.en: So when people discover flaws and security risks, that allows the AI companies to fix those flaws quickly.
cues.zh: 發現缺陷與風險，讓公司能快速修補。

cues.en: There's also a low barrier to entry because it requires literally zero technical skills.
cues.zh: 門檻低，完全不需要技術技能。

cues.en: You just have to be clever and try to outsmart the LLM, or at least outsmart the engineers who put the guardrails on the LLM.
cues.zh: 只需有創意，設法勝過 LLM，或至少勝過設置防護的工程師。

cues.en: Uh, yeah.
cues.zh: 對。

cues.en: This is basically what I just said.
cues.zh: 這基本上剛說過。

cues.en: Uh, anyone can do blackbox evals.
cues.zh: 任何人都能做黑箱評估。

cues.en: You don't need any special training in computer science or machine learning.
cues.zh: 不用特別的電腦科學、機器學習訓練。

cues.en: That means that there are millions and millions of people all over the world who can potentially help identify security risks in frontier language models.
cues.zh: 所以全世界數百萬人，都可能幫忙發現前沿模型的安全風險。

cues.en: And it is an effective technique not only for serious risks, but also for interesting and insightful
cues.zh: 不只嚴重風險，也能有效找出有趣、有洞見的

cues.en: flaws into how llms work and why they can make certain kinds of mistakes.
cues.zh: 缺陷，了解 LLM 如何運作、為何犯錯。

cues.en: I've already discussed the funny thing about counting the number of R's in a word, like strawberry in the first section of this course.
cues.zh: 第一章談過，計算 strawberry 等單字有幾個 r 的趣事。

cues.en: People have also discovered other other funny behaviors, like how models will claim that the number 8.11 is greater than the number 8.9.
cues.zh: 也有人發現，模型會說 8.11 大於 8.9。

cues.en: By the way, if you've seen this before, then what's going on here is that things like software versions increase in numbers in this pattern.
cues.zh: 如果看過，原因是軟體版本號

cues.en: So a version of a software 8.11 is actually higher.
cues.zh: 就是這樣往上增加。

cues.en: It's newer than the version 8.9.
cues.zh: 軟體 8.11，確實比 8.9 新。

cues.en: So I think black box findings like this are great because they help people without a technical background
cues.zh: 我認為這些黑箱發現很好，幫助沒技術背景的人

cues.en: understand that these language models make mistakes because they don't process information the way that humans do.
cues.zh: 理解，模型會犯錯，是因為處理資訊的方式與人類不同。

cues.en: And anything we can do to increase understanding of mechanisms and flaws is a good thing.
cues.zh: 能增進機制與缺陷理解，都是好事。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好的。

cues.en: So those are some advantages.
cues.zh: 以上是優點。

cues.en: Here are some limitations.
cues.zh: 這裡是限制。

cues.en: By this statement I mean that there's actually no mathematical or scientific principle in the approach to black box evaluations.
cues.zh: 這句話的意思是，黑箱評估方法其實沒有數學或科學原則。

cues.en: Usually when people discover flaws through black box evals, they either just find it randomly, serendipitously, or they're just trying to have fun and outsmart the LLM.
cues.zh: 通常發現缺陷，是偶然碰到，或只是為了好玩、想智取 LLM。

cues.en: That's all great, of course, and I don't mean to disparage this kind of approach, but there really
cues.zh: 當然很好，不是要貶低，

cues.en: just isn't a specific or certainly not a strict mathematical or scientific principle that guides these kinds of evaluations.
cues.zh: 但這類評估沒有特定，尤其沒有嚴格的數學、科學原則指引。

cues.en: And partly for this reason, black box approaches can only identify risks and flaws that are already present in the model.
cues.zh: 也部分因此，只能找出模型已存在的風險與缺陷。

cues.en: They don't reveal the potential for risks that people just haven't specifically tested for yet.
cues.zh: 無法揭露沒人特別測試過的潛在風險。

cues.en: And because there is no access to the internal architecture or parameters, black box evals can identify
cues.zh: 因為無法存取內部架構、參數，黑箱評估能找到

cues.en: risks or flaws, but cannot actually fix them directly.
cues.zh: 風險與缺陷，卻不能直接修正。

cues.en: Of course, if a serious flaw is identified, the engineers at AI companies can try to fix it.
cues.zh: 當然，找到嚴重缺陷，公司工程師可以試著修補。

cues.en: But the evaluation itself doesn't really suggest any mechanism of fixing or eradicating or avoiding
cues.zh: 但評估本身，不會指出如何修正、根除，

cues.en: that kind of unsafe behavior in the future.
cues.zh: 或避免未來同類不安全行為的機制。

cues.en: It's also time consuming to do this kind of stuff, because it basically just involves sitting down
cues.zh: 也很耗時，因為基本上要坐下來，

cues.en: and trying to think about clever ways to coax the model into generating text on a topic that it's not supposed to generate text about.
cues.zh: 想各種巧妙方法，誘導模型生成原本不該生成的主題文字。

cues.en: So it can take a long time, and therefore it's not really scalable, because as models become larger
cues.zh: 所以耗時，不太容易擴大規模；模型越大、

cues.en: and more capable, it becomes more difficult to identify security risks without any specific training.
cues.zh: 越強，沒有特定訓練就越難找到安全風險。

cues.en: Relatedly, it may require some expertise to identify real security risks.
cues.zh: 同樣，辨識真正風險，也可能要專業。

cues.en: For example, I know literally nothing about making explosives from chemicals that are legal to purchase.
cues.zh: 例如，我完全不懂如何用合法購買的化學品製作爆裂物。

cues.en: So even if I were somehow to get ChatGPT to tell me about recipes for explosives, I personally would
cues.zh: 即使想辦法讓 ChatGPT 說出配方，

cues.en: have no way of knowing whether it was really telling me the truth or whether the model just got tired of me asking it and gave me an incorrect answer so I would stop prompting it.
cues.zh: 也無法知道是真是假，還是它受不了一直被問，就給錯答案，希望我停止。

cues.en: And that leads me to my final point here, which is that modern, powerful llms are capable of lying and deceitful behavior.
cues.zh: 最後一點是，現代強大 LLM 能說謊、欺騙。

cues.en: A model may lie about its own unsafe behavior if it thinks that admitting to its own capabilities will lead it to lead to it being shut down.
cues.zh: 如果認為承認能力會導致被關閉，就可能對不安全能力說謊。

cues.en: That sounds very like science fiction ish, but there are many documented cases now of models doing whatever they are capable of to avoid being shut down or fine tuned.
cues.zh: 聽起來像科幻，但現在已有許多紀錄，顯示模型會盡其所能，避免被關閉或微調。

cues.en: So that's all I have to say about blackbox evals.
cues.zh: 關於黑箱評估就說到這裡。

cues.en: They are an important part of ongoing efforts to ensure AI safety.
cues.zh: 它是持續確保 AI 安全的重要一環，

cues.en: But they don't reveal anything about internal mechanisms.
cues.zh: 但不會揭露內部機制。

cues.en: And so I'm not going to discuss them further in this course.
cues.zh: 所以本課不再深入。
